spans.s: --one of the five sons of Yadu. वा. ९४. 2.

--the kingdom of राम and his son कुश. Its people celebrated राम's arrival by instituting a festival. They were taken to heaven by the grace of राम.
1: भा. IX. १०. 4 and ४२; V. १९. 8; वा. ७७. ३६; ८८. १९९; ९९. ४०२; Vi.

. १७.
Its people took part in the राजसूय of युधिष्- ठीर.
2: भा. X. ७५. १२.
Their king went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse.
3: Ib.

.
Its people met कृष्ण on the way to मिथिला with presents.
5: Ib. X. ८६. २०.
A kingdom of Madhya- देश in the Vindhyas. कुश ruled it with his capital at कुशस्थली.
6: Br. II. १६. ४१ and ६४; III. ६३. १९९; ७४. १९७.
Its king was defeated by परशुराम;
7: Ib. III. ४१. ३९; ४८. १५.
ruled by nine kings at a time.
8: Vi. IV. २४. ५९.
--a tribe; a kingdom of the Janapada on the other side of the Vindhyas. M. ११४. ३५, ५३; १६३. ६७; वा. ४५. ११०, १३३; ९९. ३८५.
